baseline_models.focus_anchor: The named blind, lame, and ill at 24:61[3,7,11], the triple حرج at [4,8,12], and the paired جميعا/أشتاتا at [55,57].
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated negation removes constriction around bodies whose access may differ, while collective and separate eating are parallel valid configurations. The protected norm is participation without forcing one bodily schedule or social format.

activation_trace.role: Severe narrowness supplies the barrier that the threefold negation removes.
Literal loss of sight anchors sensory disability rather than an abstract exemption.
Impaired gait anchors mobility difference within the meal-access rule.
Departure from health anchors fluctuating bodily capacity.
Joining what is dispersed supplies collective eating as one legitimate arrangement.
Dispersal supplies an equally legitimate alternative arrangement.

changed_reading.before: The three named people are excused from an otherwise preferred communal meal.
changed_reading.after: The verse protects accessible participation itself: differing bodies may eat with others or apart without constriction or stigma.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of eating from one's houses, kin houses, what one holds keys to, and a friend's house at 24:61[17-49].
baseline_models.mechanism: The list maps credentials of access: household identity, kinship, delegated custody, and sincere friendship. Food access therefore forms a relationship-indexed commons rather than an unrestricted license to take.

activation_trace.role: The edible share or provision branch makes eating an allocation of sustenance, not only consumption.
House-as-household turns the repeated buildings into a network of related people.
Possession and authorized disposal supply delegated standing over the keyed property.
A key as the means of reaching what is closed materializes entrusted access.
True affection and companionship supply friendship as a trust-bearing relation.

changed_reading.before: This is a list of locations from which food may be eaten.
changed_reading.after: This is a trust topology in which kinship, delegated custody, or sincere friendship can carry presumptive access to household provision.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The threshold sequence دخلتم...فسلموا على أنفسكم...تحية...مباركة طيبة at 24:61[59-69].
baseline_models.mechanism: Crossing into a household is completed by addressing its people as a shared self. Entry, safety, life, stable increase, and willing wholesomeness form a speech-act that converts access into reciprocal reception.

activation_trace.role: Movement into an interior supplies the household threshold.
Self as the very identity of a thing links your own selves with the selves greeted inside.
Freedom from harm makes the greeting enact safety at entry.
Greeting as a prayer for life and peace gives the threshold exchange its life-preserving force.
Stable, growing good makes the greeting productive beyond the moment.
Willing ease and absence of coercion make the reception inwardly agreeable as well as formally good.

changed_reading.before: One should say a pleasant religious greeting after entering a house.
changed_reading.after: Entry requires a life- and safety-giving act toward a shared social self, so food access culminates in reciprocal welcome rather than mere consumption.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier entry rules and the immediately preceding privacy rules make household permeability conditional rather than binary. Familiar welcome, authorization, maturity, privacy exposure, life stage, and restraint calibrate access; 24:61 adds body- and relationship-sensitive food access inside that architecture.

activation_trace.role: Familiarity that removes estrangement makes entry depend on relational welcome.
Explicit permission supplies a gate that relationship alone does not erase.
Attaining maturity supplies an age-sensitive change in privacy obligations.
What must remain covered supplies the protected interior around which timed access is organized.
The life-stage branch anchors a person-specific relaxation rather than a universal opening.
Restraint remaining preferable shows that legal ease can coexist with a guarded ideal.

structural_cues: 24:27-29 requires familiarizing and greeting, permission, and return before giving its own no-blame house exception.
24:58-61 repeats ليس عليكم...جناح and كذلك يبين الله around timed, age-specific, and bodily concessions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies consent, privacy windows, maturity, and person-specific relaxations; I infer one calibrated-permeability system continuing into 24:61. A live alternative is that these remain adjacent but independent rules.

changed_reading.before: Kinship or possession of keys broadly opens the listed private houses.
changed_reading.after: The verse grants relationship-indexed food access inside, not instead of, consent and privacy boundaries calibrated by person, time, maturity, and bodily condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The slander sequence depicts believers as one self and harmful speech as a received, relayed, and socially diffused substance, then contrasts vile and good. The focus greeting becomes a deliberate counter-circulation: good, safety-bearing speech is passed through the same communal household network.

activation_trace.role: Self as identity lets believers regard another believer as part of their own social self.
Receiving and transmitting speech supplies the relay mechanism of damaging talk.
Diffusion and spread supply the social propagation that the positive greeting reverses.
Vileness supplies the negative pole of the surah's moral speech environment.
Goodness and purity supply the positive pole repeated in the focus greeting.

structural_cues: 24:12 uses 'selves' for believers judging another believer, matching the focus greeting 'upon yourselves'.
24:15-19 moves harmful talk from reception to social spread, and 24:26 closes with the khabith/tayyib contrast before the house-entry section.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies corporate-self wording, a speech relay, diffusion, and the vile/good contrast; I infer salutation as a counter-flow that repairs the network. It may alternatively remain ordinary entry etiquette without this reparative function.

changed_reading.before: The salutation is courteous etiquette at a domestic threshold.
changed_reading.after: Greeting 'yourselves' with blessed-good speech repairs the communal self by circulating safety where unverified talk had circulated injury.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence from blessed light to remembering houses and apportioned provision, followed by fear being replaced with security, gives the focus chain of houses, food, keys, friends, and salutation a material function. Trusted households can operate as a distributed circuit of nourishment and settled safety.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies an orienting good that can fill and connect the house sequence.
Stable, growing good repeats the focus blessing and links material provision with durable benefit.
Vocal remembrance supplies beneficial speech located within houses.
An apportioned gift supplies the provision that the focus household network redistributes.
One state standing in place of another supplies the conversion from fear to security.
Settled trust and security supply the social state enacted by salutation and dependable food access.

structural_cues: 24:35-38 moves from blessed light to houses of remembrance and provision without reckoning.
24:55 explicitly replaces fear with security; 24:61 joins food access to a greeting rooted in safety.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the light-house-provision sequence and the fear-to-security reversal; I infer the accessible household network as one material vehicle of that state. A live alternative is that the theological sequences are parallel motifs rather than a functional chain.

changed_reading.before: The house list licenses eating from familiar stores.
changed_reading.after: It also sketches a distributed provision-and-safety circuit: trusted homes nourish members with constrained access, and salutation settles entry in peace.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context separates spatial dispersion from relational defection. Eating apart is de-moralized, while leaving a common matter is governed by explicit permission and a real personal concern; covert slipping and concealment mark the opposite failure.

activation_trace.role: A distinct faction supplies separation that becomes blameworthy through turning away, not mere distance.
A resolved gathering of purpose makes the common matter more than physical co-presence.
Requested and granted permission makes departure visible and accountable.
A genuine personal affair supplies a legitimate reason for leaving the common matter.
Slipping out supplies the concealed form of separation contrasted with permission.
Hiding behind another supplies evasion rather than acknowledged difference.

structural_cues: 24:61 permits eating جميعا or أشتاتا; 24:62 immediately regulates departure from an أمر جامع.
24:63 contrasts explicit leave with covert slipping, while 24:47 had marked a faction by its turning away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical and sequential contrast between dispersed meals, common purpose, permission, and concealed departure; I infer that accountability, not co-location, is the moral axis. The meal and public-matter rules may alternatively remain separate domains.

changed_reading.before: Together and separately are simply two equally permissible meal styles.
changed_reading.after: Unity is accountable relation rather than compulsory co-presence: one may eat apart without blame, but not convert separateness into covert withdrawal from shared responsibility.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because perceptual darkness and animal locomotion are cross-domain triggers for a human concession. It remains anchored in الأعمى/الأعرج/المريض and the together/apart option; downstream prose should call it an ecological analogy, not erase impairment or equate disabled people with animals.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The three embodied conditions and removal of حرج at 24:61[3-12], with flexible meal configuration at [55-57].

activation_trace.role: Literal blindness keeps the activation anchored in sensory embodiment.
Literal gait difference keeps the activation anchored in locomotion.
Bodily departure from health keeps fluctuating capacity inside the model.
The failed sight of one's own hand supplies a contextual limit on visual access.
Varied yet complete created forms supply a non-single bodily norm.
Repeated movement in several configurations supplies locomotor plurality.

changed_reading.before: Blindness, lameness, and illness are exceptions appended to a normal dining rule.
changed_reading.after: The concession can be carried as accommodation to a created plurality of sensory and locomotor forms, making flexible participation the norm rather than treating bodies as deviations.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is surprising because it maps cloud formation onto dining arrangements. It remains anchored in جميعا/أشتاتا through packet branches for composition, accumulation, and gaps; downstream prose should mark it as exploratory and not claim that 24:61 is secretly meteorological.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The equal permission for eating جميعا or أشتاتا at 24:61[55,57].

activation_trace.role: Joining dispersed units supplies the gathering pole.
Dispersal supplies the separation pole without making it failure.
Gentle driving supplies mobile units brought into relation without forced fusion.
Composing one thing with another supplies relational gathering.
Accumulation in layers supplies intensified association.
Productive intervals through which rain emerges supply porosity inside a gathered whole.

changed_reading.before: Together and apart name opposite, static meal arrangements.
changed_reading.after: They can also name a porous composition: persons remain mobile and distinct, gathering builds relation, and intervals need not cancel the good carried by the whole.

strongest_changes: Household access became calibrated permeability governed by consent, privacy, life stage, bodily condition, and relationship.
Greeting the shared self became a counter-circulation of good speech after the surah's anatomy of harmful speech.
Together/apart became a distinction between optional co-presence and nonoptional relational accountability.
The kin-key-friend network became a possible circuit of provision and settled safety.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence reactivated exact focus vocabulary for self, house, blessing, gathering, permission, and security, producing functional changes rather than a topical cluster.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether أنفسكم should carry a strong corporate-self force or only ordinary reciprocal grammar.
How far key-holding and friendship establish presumptive food consent in practice.
The light-security, embodiment, and cloud mechanisms are sequence-based inferences rather than explicit equations.
